display-hero.purpose: First-viewport headline in the legend margin.

heading.purpose: Sheet titles and map name, uppercase.

label.purpose: Field labels, codes, distances, buttons; uppercase condensed.

note.purpose: Legend text, step notes, helper text in Soft Ink.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: All state transitions and control-circle landing.

motion.name: map-focus
motion.purpose: Booth fade when a course focuses the map.

motion.name: control-land
motion.purpose: Control circle lands from scale 1.8 to 1.

motion.name: course-draw
motion.purpose: Course legs draw in sequence by stroke-dashoffset; static under reduced motion.

rules: The Magenta Is The Route Rule: Course Magenta appears only on the course.
The Legend Rule: every ink is a named map-key entry.
The Provenance Line Rule: built is solid, planned is dashed.
The Ruled Sheet Rule: lists are 1px black ruled rows, never cards.
The Tabular Rule: tabular numerals everywhere.
The Course Draws Itself Rule: legs draw, controls land; static under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action (Find route). Inverts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 50px; padding: 0 28px; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.25rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #fff; background: #161616; border: 2px solid #161616; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: #fff; color: #161616; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Planned Button
components.description: Disabled control for a feature not yet built; dashed per provenance rule.
components.css: .ds-go { height: 50px; padding: 0 40px; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.25rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; background: #fff; color: #464646; border: 2px dashed #464646; border-radius: 0; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Combobox Input
components.description: From/To place search; yellow focus ring, dashed when invalid.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 48px; padding: 0 14px; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; color: #161616; background: #fff; border: 2px solid #161616; border-radius: 0; appearance: none; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffd23f; outline-offset: 0; } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-style: dashed; }

components.name: Toggle
components.description: Square checkbox toggle for Wheelchair / No stairs.
components.css: .ds-toggle { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 22px 1fr; column-gap: 10px; align-items: center; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-toggle span { font-weight: 700; } .ds-toggle input { appearance: none; width: 22px; height: 22px; margin: 0; border: 2px solid #161616; background: #fff; display: grid; place-content: center; } .ds-toggle input::after { content: ''; width: 10px; height: 10px; background: #161616; transform: scale(0); transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-toggle input:checked::after { transform: scale(1); }
